blocks.title: Kharche aur budget
blocks.text: Kharche karobar chalane ki laagat hain, jaise kiraya, utilities, tankhwahein aur kachcha maal. Budget mansooba hai jo andaza lagata hai ke har shobe ko kitna paisa chahiye.

blocks.caption: Rawalpindi ki bakery ka mahana budget

blocks.text: Budget ka asal kharche se muwazna dikhata hai ke bakery zyada kharch kar rahi hai ya bacha rahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: apne pasandeeda chhote karobar ka budget banayein. Agar bakery ke utilities mansoobe se Rs 30,000 zyada nikalein to dhalne ke do tareeqe kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Kisi aur mad mein kami, maslan ajza thok mein saste khareedna, ya aamdani barhana, maslan qeematein dhalna ya zyada bechna; warna kul Rs 780,000 ho jayega.

items: Budget: mad ke hisab se mansooba kharcha (bakery kul Rs 750,000); asal se muwazna.
